openai/o1.name: OpenAI o1
openai/o1.notes: o1 will immediately return HTTP 400 if temperature, top_p, or penalties are present.

openai/o3-mini.name: OpenAI o3-mini
openai/o3-mini.notes: o3-mini will return HTTP 400 if legacy sampling options are forwarded.

anthropic/claude-3-7-sonnet.name: Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet

thinking_active.notes: When extended thinking is enabled, temperature must be 1.0 and penalties must be stripped.

anthropic/claude-3-7-sonnet.notes: Anthropic native API rejects llama.cpp samplers (typical_p, min_p, top_a).

google/gemini-2.5-pro.name: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro
google/gemini-2.5-pro.notes: Gemini API rejects non-standard samplers with 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT.

deepseek/deepseek-r1.name: DeepSeek R1
deepseek/deepseek-r1.notes: Official DeepSeek guidance: Do not use complex system prompts/jailbreaks; degrades reasoning tree.

ollama/generic.name: Ollama (Modern Release)
ollama/generic.notes: Recent Ollama builds deprecated and dropped typical_p following upstream llama.cpp removal; throws HTTP 400 (SillyTavern #6044).

xai/grok.name: xAI Grok
xai/grok.notes: Grok throws HTTP 400 if presence_penalty or frequency_penalty are sent (fixed in SillyBunny PR #755).
